# Repo-owned tcpp production header

The unmodified `source/tcppLibrary.hpp`, `LICENSE` and `README.md` come from [bnoazx005/tcpp](https://github.com/bnoazx005/tcpp) commit `8041d013d3ad97c95c1e857f0bd3f8008becb72e`, the former gitlink pin. This fork uses the single header for its shader preprocessor. The original Apache-2.0 license and author notices remain.

This is a deliberately scoped production-source copy, not a complete upstream tree. Tests and their nested Catch2 gitlink were omitted because the Mac MM7 helper does not compile them. This note is Enroth Continuum metadata.
